title: slicewright build manifest

$schema.description: JSON Schema the manifest follows, for editors; ignored by the build.

out.description: The packed PNG, relative to the manifest; its atlas goes next to it.

name.description: Texture key and file name of the atlas and stylesheet; defaults to the PNG name.

piecesDir.description: Where normalized pieces go, relative to the manifest; defaults to `pieces` beside `out`.

css.description: Also write one stylesheet with a class per piece.

groups.description: States compared after normalizing; a mismatch fails the build.

description: A `slicewright build` manifest: pieces normalized, exported, and packed into one atlas.

input.description: PNG to normalize, relative to the manifest.

name.description: Frame name and file name of the normalized piece; defaults to the input's file name.

crop.description: Crop transparent margins first; true by default.

keep.description: Rebuild keeping this many pixels of each uniform stretch span.

insets.description: Insets as `l,r,t,b`, `h,v`, or `n`, instead of detecting them.

padding.description: Content padding as `l,r,t,b`, `h,v`, or `n`, instead of detecting it.

regions.description: `multi` keeps every long stretch run on an axis, around fixed detail.

targets.description: Export targets written next to the normalized piece.

BuildPiece.description: One piece of a build: a PNG and how to normalize it.

slack.description: Largest inset or padding difference between states, in pixels; 1 by default.

sharedInsets.description: Normalize every state again with the group's shared insets.

BuildGroup.description: States of one element that swap in place, checked together after normalizing.
